source.title: A sticky HDP-HMM with application to speaker diarization

confidence_rationale: Direction = 'mixed' because this entry cuts both ways for Q-079. It covers capacity (c) -- truly unbounded latent-state birth/death, with full Bayesian posterior over the NUMBER of states and split-merge moves -- more completely than the active-inference 'spare-slot' expansion (Smith 2020), which strengthens ANSWERED-NEGATIVE for (c). BUT it covers ONLY (c): Bayesian nonparametrics gives no cyclic-coherence object (b), no scale/granularity operator (d), and no action coupling. So it also supports the research map's point that no single NON-active-inference formalism covers the combination. Held at 0.6: high methodological quality, but it speaks to one capacity, in a non-agent setting, building on Teh et al 2006 HDP.
failure_signatures: Covers only latent-state cardinality (capacity c); provides nothing for cyclic coherence (b), scale shift (d), or action coupling.
State discovery is offline-batch posterior inference over time-series segments, not online action-coupled graph transformation.

mapping.source_claim_statement: A hierarchical Dirichlet process prior over HMM transition matrices supports a countably infinite state space, enabling full Bayesian posterior inference over the NUMBER of latent states; the sticky extension controls switching rate and a split-merge sampler proposes birth/merge of states.
mapping.ree_translation: DLIF capacity (c) -- latent-node birth/death/merge/split with genuinely unbounded cardinality -- is a mature, separate formalism (BNP). It is the strongest single-capacity coverage of (c), but it delivers ONLY (c).
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is the non-degeneracy cross-check: it proves (c) is well-covered AND that a NON-active-inference formalism covers only one capacity. The four-capacity combination requires assembling BNP-style structure learning WITH the active-inference substrate -- an engineering synthesis, not a new mathematical object.
mapping.source_context: Bayesian statistics / time-series; speaker diarization benchmark. No agent, no action, no moral content.

confidence_components.notes: Top-tier authors and venue (Jordan/Willsky; Annals of Applied Statistics). Mapping fidelity moderate because it covers a single capacity and in a passive batch-inference setting far from REE's online action-coupled use.
